name: Bjøntegaard Delta PSNR (BD-PSNR) and BD-BR
definition: Metrics used to evaluate lossy compression performance by calculating the average difference in quality (BD-PSNR) or bit-rate (BD-BR) between two rate-distortion curves.
summary: BD-PSNR and BD-BR are metrics that calculate the average quality or bit-rate difference between two rate-distortion curves using piecewise cubic interpolation to provide a single scalar for objective compression comparison.
